name: Calendar
description: A month view with events and reminders that arrive as notifications.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: month view, events, reminders, 'calendar today'.
changelog.1.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.

optional.why: timers and alarms next to your events
